_about: Battle Brothers injuries, extracted from the fandom wiki dump (2256 pages). 48 temporary + 11 permanent = 59 rows. Each row comes from the injury's own card page (threshold, effects, heal days, flavor); kind and damage_type/body_part come from which section of the 'Temporary Injuries' / 'Permanent Injuries' page transcludes it (an injury listed under two types, e.g. Grazed Neck under Cutting and Piercing, gets both). Effects keys: *_pct = percent change as written (−50% Melee Skill -> melee_skill_pct: -50); extra_ap_per_tile_moved, action_points, vision, fatigue_recovery_per_turn, hitpoints_lost_per_turn_in_combat are flat. threshold_pct_of_max_hp: the injury happens if damage ÷ max hitpoints ≥ threshold × multipliers (see rules). Every row was cross-checked against the Injuries page Effects and Parameters tables; cross_check says the result. Conflicts found: ['Exposed Ribs']. Extraction 2026-10-02, research only.

what.quote: Injuries are (mostly) negative status effects inflicted upon getting hit for a certain amount of damage by regular attacks or sustained after some events. Injuries can be temporary or permanent.

temporary_base_conditions.quote: Successful attacks can inflict injuries if these conditions are met: the target can receive injuries; damage received ≥ 10 hitpoints

temporary_threshold_formula.quote: injury = injury threshold × injury threshold multiplier × inflict injury threshold multiplier × receive injury threshold multiplier × bonus ≤ damage ÷ max hitpoints
temporary_threshold_formula.quote_selection: a random injury of a type that depends on the weapon used is selected among possible candidates. All candidates have the same chance to be selected (no distinction is made between light and heavy injuries for instance).
temporary_threshold_formula.quote_range: Injuries have different thresholds comprised between 25% and 60% of maximum hitpoints

injury_threshold_multiplier.quote: the injury threshold multiplier is not currently modified by anything

inflict_injury_threshold_multiplier_crip.quote: modified by the Crippling Strikes perk which sets it at 0.66 effectively reducing the threshold by 33%

receive_injury_threshold_multiplier_iron.quote: modified by the Iron Jaw trait which sets it at 1.25 effectively raising the threshold by 25%

bonus_head_hit.quote: the bonus multiplier is set to 1.25 if the head was hit (critical hits deal more damage)

temporary_threshold_formula.quote_compare: The result is compared to the relative amount of hitpoints lost. So reducing incoming damage or increasing the maximum amount of hitpoints helps avoid injuries. Suffering an injury will cause a mood drop.

damage_types.blunt: A non penetrating injury caused by blunt weapons that bruise organs and crush bones.
damage_types.cutting: An incised injury caused by sharp weapons that slash the skin clean and sever tissues.
damage_types.piercing: A deep penetrating injury caused by weapons that stab and puncture the skin.
damage_types.note: each type is split into Body and Head lists; the wiki gives no description line for Burning

immune_to_injuries.iron_will_potion: The Iron Will Potion makes brothers not affected by injuries and immune to new temporary injuries for the duration of a battle.

temporary_healing.quote: Cure (removal): medicine and time; bandages for hemorrhaging injuries (Grazed Neck, Cut Neck Vein, Cut Artery) but only during the battle they were sustained; the Wound Heals event. Treatment (halves healing time): in a settlement temple for a price; the Apothecary's Miracle drug. Injuries that have not been treated can fester (Wound Gets Infected).
temporary_healing.temple_price_formula: price = base wound treatment price (20) × treatment price multiplier (1) × settlement prices multiplier × max remaining healing time (in days) × (1 + (character level - 1) × 0.2)

permanent.quote: Permanent injuries are incurable disabilities received after having been struck down in battle or rarely after experiencing certain events. Consuming the Water Skin legendary item is the only way to remove a permanent injury. Suffering a permanent injury aggravates mood.
permanent.quote_struck_down: A character whose hitpoints have reached 0 has a chance of surviving with a random permanent injury an otherwise fatal blow. Surviving is not possible if: the last hit was a fatality; the character was retreating; the damage was self inflicted (result of an effect like bleeding, poison, etc.) The chance to survive is 33% or 90% with the Survivor trait. The part hit does not matter in selecting the injury.
permanent.quote_after: If a character survives, the combat log will display 'struck down' instead of 'killed' or 'died'. Surviving characters cannot be eaten by Nachzehrers or reanimated as Wiedergangers.

events_injury_lists.note: The Temporary Injuries page also lists which injuries events can give (Brawl, Mountains, Flagellation, Accident_1/2/3); not copied here
